summary: Nano Labs Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release and notice for its 2026 Annual General Meeting, to be held November 24, 2026 (Beijing time) in Hangzhou, with a record date of October 16, 2026. Agenda items include authorizing a ten-for-one share consolidation, a contingent re-designation into Class A and Class B ordinary shares, a reverse share sub-division contingent on the price exceeding US$100 for 30 trading days, and ratification of MaloneBailey, LLP as auditor for fiscal 2026. No transaction terms, board recommendation beyond the proposals, or advisors are stated. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; watch the consolidation vote and any Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance implications.
